**Question.** How close can the c8 DFlash2 path get to the measured target oracle after removing serial draft kernels?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| node | `gx10-5e36` and peer, 2x NVIDIA GB10 |
| target fuel | GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 |
| draft | GLM-5.3-Flash DFlash2 BF16, seven draft tokens |
| commit | `0008e257cbeff33e07ea3cf3a3863ce60a42697b` |

```bash
ROCKET_FUEL_NVFP4_DIR=$HOME/.cache/rocket-fuels/glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4 \
ROCKET_PACKED_WEIGHTS=$HOME/.cache/rocket-fuels/glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4/resident-packed.bin \
ROCKET_FP8_ATTN_DIR=$HOME/.cache/rocket-fuels/overlays/fp8-all \
ROCKET_KDA_CUBLAS=1 ROCKET_CUBLAS_ALL=1 \
ROCKET_DFLASH2_DIR=$HOME/.cache/rocket-glm53-exl3-host/models/glm-5.3-flash-dflash2 \
GLM53_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 BATCH=8 SPEC=8 TOKENS=256 \
EXPERT_CACHE_GIB=90 MAX_TOKENS=512 \
PROMPT='Count from 1 to 50: 1, 2, 3,' \
scripts/runtime/glm53-nvfp4-spec-bench.sh
```

```text
rank 0: preloaded 6048 owned experts, 88.59 GiB in 89.4 s
spec rounds=33 drafted=1848 accepted=1808 + committed=264 (97.8%)
decode median 317.7 ms/step (197.63 aggregate, 24.70 tokens/s/stream)
dflash2 propose 17.2 ms median
dflash2 context 0.1 ms median
```

| metric | before | after | unit |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| throughput per stream | 23.91 | 24.70 | tokens/s |
| aggregate throughput | 191.26 | 197.63 | tokens/s |
| median round | 323.2 | 317.7 | ms |
| DFlash2 proposal | 20.8 | 17.2 | ms |
| draft acceptance | 96.1 | 97.8 | % |
| fraction of matching 27.06 oracle | 88.4 | 91.3 | % |

Changes: four-key attention score blocks, parallel softmax, fused RMSNorm and RoPE, fused Q/V and gate/up projections, tree top-16 reduction, selector projection overlap with candidate exchange, and removal of the EXL3 path.

Both ranks reported the same acceptance count and output. Run-to-run round time has ranged from 317.7 to 323.2 ms across the two 256-token gates.

A 256-token SPEC=8 perfect-draft control measured 295.7 ms per target round and 27.06 tokens/s per stream. Adding the real draft's 17.2 ms cost gives a 25.57 tokens/s practical ceiling. The measured 24.70 result is 96.6% of that ceiling.

**Verdict.** Accepted. The engine is 19.9% above the 20.6 tokens/s per-stream vLLM baseline, 91.3% of the matching target-only oracle, and 96.6% of the target-plus-draft ceiling.

**Next.**

- Materialize owned experts in final slot order to replace the 89.4 s mmap preload.

**Reopen if.**

- A driver, firmware, or GB10 memory-clock change moves the measured hardware roofline.
